title: Warmly Spiced Venezuelan Umeboshi Skewers
description: A festive and herbal Venezuelan dish featuring umeboshi, perfect for any occasion, made with a tadka seasoning blend and served on a tagliere

ingredients.name: umeoshi plums
ingredients.notes: dried and soaked in water for 4 hours

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Soak the umeboshi plums in water for 4 hours, then drain and set aside.
In a large bowl, whisk together the tadka seasoning blend, olive oil, garlic, and ginger.
Add the sliced red onion and red bell pepper to the bowl and toss to coat with the tadka mixture.
Thread a piece of umeboshi, a slice of red onion, and a slice of red bell pepper onto each bamboo skewer.
Place the skewers on a tagliere and bake in the preheated oven for 15 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers warm, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
